description: Grid mode keybinding in real Positron: Cmd/Ctrl+G toggles 2×2 grid mode on and off; grid state is reflected in the Atlas state object.
setup:
import numpy as np, pandas as pd
rng = np.random.default_rng(42)
k = rng.integers(0, 3, 2000)
df = pd.DataFrame(rng.normal(0, 1, (2000, 10)) + k[:, None] * 3, columns=[f'x{i}' for i in range(10)])
df['cluster'] = [f'grp_{v}' for v in k]

steps.name: focus the map with a real click
press Cmd+G (Meta+g): VS Code command toggles grid mode on
steps.report: { enabled: a.grid.enabled, layout: a.grid.layout, nPanels: a.grid.panels.length }

steps.name: press Cmd+G again: grid mode toggles off
